purpose: Machine-readable Phase 5 database migration bundle plan for the future standalone backend database package.
scope: Maps current SQL assets from database-sql-ownership-inventory.json to target backend migration bundle entries.
Separates ordered core migrations, optional AI retrieval migrations, development seed/compat data, duplicate-only evidence, and excluded non-platform SQL.
notes: This manifest maps to package-owned migration bundle scaffold files under packages/database for runnable core, optional AI retrieval, and development seed entries.
packages/database/migrations/supabase/migration-index.json is generated from this manifest and package-owned files as an ordered apply-plan/checksum artifact for future migration runners.

The scaffold files are extraction artifacts only. They do not execute SQL, create a database, prove RLS or tenant isolation, prove live seeded backend parity, prove durable idempotency, or complete standalone database package extraction.
